audit_items.proof_trace: Implementation correctly uses TryPeek() to retrieve the most recent transaction-start snapshot (L106), then searches for the last change before that snapshot (L110-112). This returns the storage value at the start of the CURRENT transaction, as required by EIP-2200/EIP-1283 for SSTORE gas metering. The property assertion demanding the "first" snapshot [0] contradicts EIP-2200, which defines "original value" as the value at current transaction start, not block start.
